summary: D1-PR-001 is resolved and the carried-forward Proposal bundle remains structurally valid, but the Action precondition requirement permits review-S when the current matching Verdict is changes-requested. That conflicts with the required next action revise-S and would let unified review bypass Revision.

blockingFindings.title: review-S precondition permits a Review when the matching Verdict requires Revision
blockingFindings.evidence: The Spec's lineage requirement says match + changes-requested -> next revise-S, but its Change-level Action precondition requirement also permits review-explore when Current Review is 'match+changes-requested'. The unified review entry delegates to canRun(review-S), so this permits another review before the required revise-S. This conflicts with docs/delivery-lifecycle.md: explore -> review-explore -> changes-requested: revise-explore -> review-explore and the analogous propose/apply loops.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: For every stage S, define canRun(review-S) as allowed only when the current artifact has no current review or has no lineage match. A matching changes-requested verdict must allow only revise-S; remove the contradictory match+changes-requested condition and add table-driven scenarios proving unified review blocks until the revision produces a new artifact. Update Design, Spec, and Tasks consistently without altering prior Runs.
